server.note: ready_ms is the figure that Vite printed. The Playwright library drove the rows (driver.mjs in the evidence directory), because the rows need several clean contexts, two engines, touch emulation and download files. Each row and variant ran in new contexts: desktop is Chromium at 1280x800, iphone is WebKit with iPhone 13 emulation, pixel is Chromium with Pixel 7 emulation. Each check lists the assertions and evidence of its first variant, shortened. driver-results-main.json and driver-results-extra.json hold all values and all variants. driver-results-extra.json holds AC-3.27. headed-picker.mjs ran one headed Chromium for AC-3.43, and headed-picker.out holds its result. doctor.mjs stop reported free_after true.

preconditions.what: With the archive save dialog open, the editor element has the inert attribute and the dialog is outside the editor element. action-save-archive shows Архів з фото, and the file input of action-open-file accepts .zip. The feature introduced these.

deviations.what: AC-3.16, AC-3.18, AC-3.19, AC-3.21, AC-3.26, AC-3.27, AC-3.28, AC-3.31, AC-3.36, AC-3.37 and AC-3.38 ran only on desktop Chromium, and the OS dialog of showOpenFilePicker cannot be driven: headless Chromium rejects it at once with an AbortError. The driver used a stub of showOpenFilePicker that takes the file from a real file chooser, or it removed the function so that the app takes its file input route. AC-3.16 also has a showDirectoryPicker stub on browser storage, because the print export asks for a folder.
deviations.why: The app receives a File through the same code after the dialog. The other open rows also ran on WebKit with the real file input route, so they are not in this list.

deviations.what: AC-3.27 failed two times in driver-results-main.json at one driver step, and then passed after a change to the driver. The old driver read window.__store directly after a page reload, before the app set it. The failure screenshot shows the restored editor with використано 2 / 2. The driver now waits for photo-counter after the reload. driver-results-extra.json holds the passing run, on the same code.
deviations.why: This is a race of the driver, so it is not a product failure and it is not recorded as a flake of the app. AC-3.27.failure.png and AC-3.27.retry1.failure.png are the evidence.

deviations.what: After 30 presses of the Tab key the focus was on archive-close, so the Enter key of the row closed the dialog. The album JSON was equal after the 30 presses and after the Enter key. SWEEP.tab-enter-save-dialog also pressed Enter at each other stop with the dialog open, and no edit changed.
deviations.why: The row names 30 presses, and the stop after 30 presses follows from the three stops of the dialog cycle.

deviations.what: Sweep finding outside the rows: on desktop at 1280 px and 900 px, 18 pixels at the rounded corners of the thumb photo-land-2.jpg differ after the archive save dialog opened, with the largest channel difference 5 of 255. The same 18 pixels differ with the dialog hidden and after the close. The page was still before the open, and the settings dialog and the export dialog gave 0 different pixels. All element boxes were equal. Phone widths gave 0 different pixels. The first version of this assertion required 0 different pixels, and it failed on desktop. The limit of a channel difference of at most 8 was set after that result, so this assertion does not prove that the pixels are equal.
deviations.why: No row covers this and it is not visible to a person, so it does not fail a row. The cause was not determined. Evidence: SWEEP.layout-save-dialog@desktop-1280 and @desktop-900 in driver-results-main.json.

deviations.what: Sweep measures outside the rows: a double click on open-file on the file input route gave 2 file choosers and 0 alerts. A stub that refuses each call at once gave 2 calls and 2 alerts, because each click had its own refused call. A cancel of a held picker gave 0 alerts, and the next click started a new picker.
deviations.why: AC-3.43 names a held picker, and it passed. Evidence: SWEEP.double-click-open-file@desktop in driver-results-main.json.
